Government of UP
Industrial Development Department; Section -4
No. 4495/77-4-26/102Appeal/25
Lucknow: Dated 25.08.2026
M/s Ghaziabad Developers & Builders .... Revisionist
Vs
Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority (GNIDA) .... Respondent

1. The present revision petition has been preferred by M/s Ghaziabad Developers &
 Builders under Section 41(3) of the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and
 Development Act, 1973 read with Section 12 of the Uttar Pradesh Industrial Area
 Development Act, 1976, assailing the demand letters dated 19.12.2022 and
 21.12.2023 and the order dated 09.07.2025 passed by the Respondent Authority
 ( impugned orders) denying the benefit of the production incentive to the
 revisionist in relation to Plot No. 2, Sector Ecotech-IV, G.T. Road, Greater Noida.

2. The relevant facts, in brief, are that the aforesaid plot was originally allotted to
 M/s Samtel Colors Ltd (hereinafter referred to as the Original Allottee); which
 subsequently went into liquidation being unable to repay their debt. The
 Revisionist acquired the property in liquidation proceedings e-auction
 conducted on 29.07.2022 by the Resolution Professional (RP) appointed for this
 purpose by the New Delhi Principal Bench of National Company Law
 Tribunal(NCLT) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Upon
 payment of the auction consideration, a Sale Certificate dated 20.10.2022 was
 issued in favour of the Revisionist. The Respondent Authority had also conveyed
 it's no objection to the transfer of the property in favour of the Revisionist
 subject to the condition that dues owed by the Original Allottee in favour of the
 respondents be settled first. The claim submitted on behalf of the Respondent
 Authority reflected an overall due amount of Rs 41,96, 97,931/- (Rs Forty-One
 crore, ninety-six lacs, Ninety-Seven Thousand, Nine Hundred and Thirty-One
 only) as on 31.07.2020 further partitioned under different heads such as lease
 rent, balance lease premium and Construction/Functional Penalty.

3. The chief bone of contention among the parties to the revision is in regard to the
 applicability or otherwise of the construction/ functional penalty that is sought
 to be levied upon the Revisionist as a pre-condition for effectuating the mutation
 in their favour in the records of the Respondent Authority as also the credit
 adjustment that is sought by the Revisionist in lieu of the excess payment made
